question: Should Skill Workshop permanently expose the `review` action and optional `proposal_version` lifecycle contract in core?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent but adds public model-facing and CLI behavior whose permanence cannot be inferred from tests or the contributor proposal.

options.title: Adopt the contract
options.body: Approve the core review action and optional version binding after live-flow proof and branch refresh.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep exact previewing but redesign or omit the permanent lifecycle parameter surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the paired issue and draft PR open until an owner sponsors the direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt the contract
recommendation.body: Approve the core review action and optional version binding after live-flow proof and branch refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history spans Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals, prompt contract, reliability fixes, and curator behavior.
